_comment: SCP: Deny Disabling or Modifying CloudTrail
_purpose: Denies selected CloudTrail configuration changes in member accounts. It does not protect the Organizations management account or prevent changes outside the listed API actions.
_threat_closed: Attempts to stop or alter the selected organization CloudTrail configuration from member accounts.
_design_note: A separate SCP and destination bucket policy deny selected log deletion actions. These controls are not S3 Object Lock and do not constrain the Organizations management account.
